title: Ox Passion Pineapple Freeze Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Pineapple Freeze brings together the bright, tropical sweetness of Pineapple with an icy cool finish. The juicy, golden pineapple flavour bursts over the tastebuds with its recognisable tangy-sweet profile, while a crisp wave of cooling menthol lifts the exhale, delivering a fresh and uplifting finish. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, ensuring well-defined flavour with a consistently smooth throat hit. Ideal for pod vape kits and starter devices, it provides rapid nicotine absorption for a satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range features expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
